chapter_title: The Explanation of the Peace, what it is; the Righ
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Five Mysteries of the Celestial Human

---

**¶1:** These states of interior peace and mutual recognition of good that arise in the natural mind — [from w]hom [did they proceed]? And likewise, the divine power that operates in [the natural mind, being] honored by all human faculties — to whom does it belong? And the mystery of the conjunction of affections by which interior goods unite with one another [GAP-1: *(the spiritual sense requires here a question about the origin of this conjunction, following the pattern of the surrounding questions: from what divine source does it proceed?)*]? And who is the one that reveals this reverent acknowledgment by which the faculties of the mind bow before one another? And this communication of interior authority, which a supremely celestial good bestows upon what is subordinate to it, conferring upon it dignity and elevating it — to whom does this transmission of authority belong?

---

**¶2:** These five modes of spiritual conjunction are the mystery of the Celestial Human. He came forth with them from the kingdom of divine wisdom. And when he completed his spiritual combat, he ascended again bearing these beneficent modes of conjunction. The heavenly societies received him into the kingdoms of divine wisdom.

---

**¶3:** The first interior peace is that which the celestial goods and angelic intelligences within the realm of divine wisdom gave to the Celestial Human when he goes forth against the adversary. The celestial goods and angelic intelligences were accompanying him, escorting him, giving him their peace and their power, their blessing and their spiritual fortification. This is the first interior peace that the celestial goods and angelic intelligences gave to the Celestial Human as he comes forth from the kingdom of divine wisdom.

---

**¶4:** The first communication of divine power is that which the Divine Wisdom gave to the Celestial Human when he goes forth into spiritual combat.

---

**¶5:** The first conjunction of love is that with which the Divine Wisdom embraced the Celestial Human as he separates from her, descending into spiritual combat. Indeed all the celestial goods and angelic intelligences that dwell in the kingdoms of divine wisdom were striving to unite themselves with him! [GAP-2: *(the spiritual sense requires additional categories of heavenly goods and truths that also sought this conjunction)*] All of them also, and the guardian truths of the spiritual community, and the kindred goods belonging to the society of his people — they were striving to unite with him as [GAP-3: *(the Celestial Human)*] separates from them, accompanying him forth, conjoining with him through the embrace of mutual affection and love.

---

**¶6:** The first act of humble reverence is the acknowledgment with which the Celestial Human made obeisance when he comes forth [GAP-4: *(into the depths of spiritual obscurity)*] below. He was bowing his will in humility, making reverent acknowledgment before the Divine Truth in its supreme essence, and all the heavenly states [GAP-5: *(of divine wisdom)*] belonging to the society of his people, entreating them for a power to accompany him as he comes forth.

---

**¶7:** The first transmission of interior authority is that which the Divine Wisdom bestowed upon the inmost of the Celestial Human. She armed him with truths and made him mighty in good. She communicated her power to him and sent him forth into the combat. He descended into temptation. He completed his struggle against the great powers of evil and their enmity.

---

**¶8:** By [GAP-6: *(the)*]se five modes of conjunction and these five spiritual mysteries, the Celestial Human came forth from the kingdoms of divine wisdom against the adversary. He subdued him. He was victorious over him through them.

---

**¶9:** And when he ascended out of the combat of temptation, he entered into the kingdom of the society of his people through these five spiritual mysteries.

---

**¶10:** The interior peace with which he ascended is the peace that the divine call gave to him, when it was sent forth from the Divine Love. It gave him peace within the very state of falsity and evil. And that peace with which he had descended is the same as that with which he ascended from the struggle. *(Note: The continuity of this peace — that it is the same descending and ascending — signifies that the conjunction between the Divine and the Celestial Human is never broken, even in the deepest states of temptation. The divine call that penetrates into the state of falsity carries with it the same quality of interior rest that attended the original mission.)*

---

**¶11:** This second communication of divine power is that which the Proceeding Divine Truth gave to the Celestial Human, when it raised him upward out of the struggle.

---

**¶12:** This second conjunction of love is that with which the Divine Love and the Divine Wisdom embraced the Celestial Human when he ascended from the struggle.

---

**¶13:** [GAP-7: *(The)*] second act of humble reverence, with which the Celestial Human made acknowledgment [GAP-8: *(upon his return, at this)*] time before the Divine Truth in its supreme essence and [GAP-9: *(before all)*] the blessed heavenly states and all the kingdoms [GAP-10: *(throughout the)*] whole [GAP-11: *(realm)*] of divine wisdom — when the Divine Love and the Divine Wisdom brought the Celestial Human upward from the abyss of temptation.

---

**¶14:** The second transmission of interior authority is this: When the Proceeding Divine Truth brought the Celestial Human upward from the combat, it saved him from all the surging floods of falsity. It raised him upward, it gave him rest within the exalted kingdoms of divine wisdom that belong to the society of his people. It established [GAP-12: *(him)*] firmly before the Divine Itself, the Lord of all that exists. He received this great transmission of interior authority so that he might become the governing principle among kindred celestial goods in the regenerate state.

---

**¶15:** These five spiritual mysteries and these five modes of conjunction originated first within the Divine Itself. These mysteries did not exist at the beginning among the powers of falsity and evil.

*(Note: This paragraph states the essential doctrine that all genuine modes of spiritual conjunction — peace, power, love, humility, and communicated authority — have their origin solely in the Divine, and that nothing of them existed within evil and falsity. Evil can counterfeit them outwardly but cannot generate them. They proceed from above, never from below.)*

---

**¶20:** At the time of their departing from the natural state, the Form of Divine Truth shall come forth before them, and she redeems them from falsity into the light of wisdom [GAP-13: *(the spiritual sense requires here an elaboration of the transition from spiritual darkness into illumination, perhaps describing the stages of liberation or the fullness of what is given)*]. This Form of Divine Truth calms the departing spirit through the conjunction of her love and her tranquility, from the terror of the evil spirits who assail and destroy the natural body. By her radiance and her likeness [GAP-14: *(the)*] heart of the regenerate one, who is coming forth from his corporeal state, shall find peace [GAP-15: *(within him)*]. Afterwards, the angelic intelligence who bears the crown of spiritual victory extends to him the divine power. And it draws him out of the abyss of his corporeal state, and receives him through the conjunction of love and affection. That interior spirit shall make reverent acknowledgment before its liberator, who is this Form of Divine Truth.

---

## Summary Note on the Correspondential Structure

The chapter teaches that five essential modes of spiritual conjunction — interior peace, communicated power, the union of affections, humble acknowledgment, and the transmission of authority — all originated in the Divine and were carried by the Celestial Human into the combat of temptation. The descent and ascent of the Celestial Human is the universal form of all regeneration: the same five modes that equip the will for combat are the same five by which it is received back into heavenly states after victory. The chapter's deepest teaching is in ¶10: the peace given in the descent is *the same* peace that attends the ascent. The Divine conjunction is not interrupted by temptation but passes through it unbroken. What changes is not the quality of the conjunction but the Human's reception of it — tried, proven, and now governing.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: This peace and this greeting that occur in the world, [from w]hom [did they come fo]rth? Or likewise, the right hand that occurs in [the world, it being h]onoured by mankind, of whom is it? Or the mystery of the kiss that they embrace one another with, [of whom is it]? Or who is the one that reveals this salutation with which they make obeisance to one another? Or this laying on of hands, which an immensely great one bequeaths upon his inferior, giving him an honour and making him great; of whom is this laying on of hands?

these five signs are the mystery of the First Man. He came forth with them from the aeon of light. Also, when he finished his contest, he went up with these good signs. They received him into the aeons of light.

The first peace is the one that the gods and the angels in the land of light gave to the First Man; when he comes out against the enemy. The gods and the angels were walking with him; escorting him, giving to him their peace and power, and their blessing and fortification. This is the first peace that the gods and the angels gave to the First Man; as he comes forth from the aeon of light.
The first right hand is the one that the Mother of Life gave to the First Man; when he comes out to the contest.

The first kiss is this one with which the Mother of Life embraced the First Man; as he separates from her, coming down to the contest. Even all the gods and the angels who are in the aeons of light were making to embrace him! [ ... ] all of them also, and the church tutelaries (?), and the kinsfolk who belong to the household of his people. They were making to embrace him as [he] separates from them, accompanying him out, embracing him with the kiss of affection and love.

The first salutation is the salutation with which the First Man made obeisance; when he comes out [to the depths] below. He was bending his knees, making obeisance to the God of truth, and all the aeons [of light] who belong to the household of his people; entreating them for a power to escort him, as he comes forth.

The first laying on of hands is the one that the Mother of Life bequeathed upon the head of the First Man. She armed him and made him mighty. She laid hands on him, and sent him to the battle. He descended. He completed his struggle with the great powers and the enmity.
By the [se] five signs and these five myst[e]ri[es] the First Man came forth from the aeons of light against the enemy. He humbled him. He was victorious against him by them.
Also, when he ascended from the war, he came in to the kingdom of the household of his people by these five mysteries!

The peace with which [he ascen]ded is the peace that the summons gave to him, [w]hen it was sent forth from the [Fa]ther of Life. It gave him the peace in the world of darkness. Also, that peace with which he descended is th[e sam]e as the one with which he ascended from the struggle!
this second right hand is the one that the Living Spirit gave the First Man, when he [brou]ght him upward out from the struggle.
this second kiss is the one with which the [Father o]f Life and the Mother of the living embraced the First Man, when he ascended from the struggle.

[The] second salutation with which the First Man made obeisance [again at] time to the God of truth and [before all] the blessed aeons and al[l] the aeons [in the] whole [land] of light, whe[n] the Father of Life and the Mother of the living brought the Man upward from the abyss of the struggle.

The second laying on of hands is this: When the Living Spirit brought the First Man upward from the war, he saved him from all the surging waves. He brought him upward, he gave him ease in the great aeons of light, which belong to the household of his people. He set [him] firmly before the Father, the Lord of the totality. He received this great laying on of hands that he may become leader of his brethren in the new aeon.
These five mysteries and these five signs came about first in the divine. these mysteries were not at the beginning amongst the powers of Darkness.

At the time of their coming forth, the Light Form shall come forth before them; and she redeems them from the darkness to the light [and from death to the life.] This Light Form calms the person, with the kiss and her quiet, from fear of the demons w[ho de]stroy his body. By her asp[ec]t and her image [the] heart of the elect one, who is come forth from his bo[d]y, shall be calm for [him]. Afterwards, the angel who h[o]lds the victory prize extends to him the right hand. And it draws him out of the abyss of his body, and accepts him in with the [k]iss and love. That soul shall make obeisance to its red[eem]er, who is this Light Form.

fills.explanation: The paragraph follows a consistent rhetorical pattern where each of the five mysteries is followed by a question about its divine origin ("of whom is it?" / "of whom is this laying on of hands?"), and the kiss requires the same interrogative formula.

The subject is the First Man, matching the parallel clause earlier in the paragraph ("as he separates from her"), and the spiritual reading confirms the Celestial Human as the one who separates from them.
The First Man descends to combat below, and the spiritual reading confirms "into the depths of spiritual obscurity" which in the Kephalaia's natural register is "to the depths below."
"Aeons of light" is the standard Manichaean formula for the heavenly kingdoms, and the spiritual reading's "of divine wisdom" corresponds to "of light" in the Kephalaia's vocabulary.
The partial word completes "these" ("By these five signs"), which is confirmed by the spiritual reading and the demonstrative pattern used throughout the chapter.

The definite article begins the description of the second salutation, matching the pattern of all other second-mystery paragraphs ("The second laying on of hands," "this second right hand," "this second kiss").

The second salutation parallels the first (¶6) but occurs upon ascent rather than descent; "again at this time" conveys the repeated act of obeisance on this second occasion, matching the spiritual reading's "upon his return, at this time."

The act of obeisance requires a preposition of reverent positioning; the spiritual reading specifies "before all the blessed heavenly states," and "before" suits the gesture of making obeisance in the presence of the aeons.

The aeons exist within the land of light; "in the" matches the spiritual reading's "throughout the" and reflects the standard Manichaean locative construction placing the aeons within the whole land of light.
"Land of light" is the standard Manichaean designation for the divine realm, and the spiritual reading's "realm of divine wisdom" translates directly to "land of light" in the Kephalaia.
The Living Spirit is establishing the First Man before the Father; "him" is the only grammatically possible pronoun referring to the First Man as the object of this action.

fills.explanation: The paired formula "from the darkness to the light, and from death to the life" is a standard Manichaean soteriological formula attested across Kephalaia and other texts, completing the transition from spiritual obscurity to illumination described in the spiritual reading.
The definite article is required before "heart of the elect one" to form a grammatical subject, and the spiritual reading confirms this construction.
The elect one's heart "shall be calm for him" — the pronoun refers reflexively to the elect one who has come forth from his body, and the spiritual reading's "within him" confirms this referent.
